PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX ontolex: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/ontolex#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?parmigianoLemma ?parmigianoWord
WHERE {
  ?parmigianoLemma dcterms:isPartOf <http://liita.it/data/id/DialettoParmigiano/lemma/LemmaBank> .
  ?parmigianoLemma ontolex:writtenRep ?parmigianoWord .
  FILTER(regex(str(?parmigianoWord), "(er|ér|èr)$"))
}

PREFIX dct: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX dcterms: <http://purl.org/dc/terms/>
PREFIX elita: <http://w3id.org/elita/>
PREFIX lexinfo: <http://www.lexinfo.net/ontology/3.0/lexinfo#>
PREFIX lila: <http://lila-erc.eu/ontologies/lila/>
PREFIX lime: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/lime#>
PREFIX marl: <http://www.gsi.upm.es/ontologies/marl/ns#>
PREFIX ontolex: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/ontolex#>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX vartrans: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/vartrans#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?italianWord ?emotion ?emotionLabel
WHERE {
  SERVICE <https://klab.ilc.cnr.it/graphdb-compl-it/> {
    ?theatreWord ontolex:canonicalForm [ ontolex:writtenRep ?theatreWr ] ;
                 ontolex:sense ?theatreSense .
    FILTER(STR(?theatreWr) = "teatro")

    ?partSense lexinfo:partMeronym ?theatreSense .

    ?partWord ontolex:sense ?partSense .
  }

  ?partWord ontolex:canonicalForm ?italianLemma .

  GRAPH <http://liita.it/data> {
    ?italianLemma a ?italianLemmaType ;
                  ontolex:writtenRep ?italianWord .
    FILTER(?italianLemmaType IN (lila:Lemma, lila:Hypolemma))
  }

  ?emotionEntry ontolex:canonicalForm ?italianLemma .

  GRAPH <http://w3id.org/elita> {
    ?emotionEntry elita:HasEmotion ?emotion .
    ?emotion rdfs:label ?emotionLabel .
  }
}

PREFIX lexinfo: <http://www.lexinfo.net/ontology/3.0/lexinfo#>
PREFIX ontolex: <http://www.w3.org/ns/lemon/ontolex#>

SELECT DISTINCT ?hypernymWord ?hypernymWr
WHERE {
  SERVICE <https://klab.ilc.cnr.it/graphdb-compl-it/> {
    ?melaWord ontolex:canonicalForm [ ontolex:writtenRep ?melaWr ] .
    FILTER(STR(?melaWr) = "mela")
    ?melaWord ontolex:sense ?melaSense .

    ?peraWord ontolex:canonicalForm [ ontolex:writtenRep ?peraWr ] .
    FILTER(STR(?peraWr) = "pera")
    ?peraWord ontolex:sense ?peraSense .

    ?melaSense lexinfo:hyponym ?commonSense .
    ?peraSense lexinfo:hyponym ?commonSense .

    ?hypernymWord ontolex:sense ?commonSense ;
                  ontolex:canonicalForm [ ontolex:writtenRep ?hypernymWr ] .
  }
}
